changelog.text: Enhanced Desktop UI with a Linux-style header bar.
Introduced Continue Watching across Mobile, TV, and Desktop.
Added Netra Share with QR-based device sharing and custom download locations.
Enhanced deep link support with improved cross-platform sharing.
Improved media extraction, Google Video playback, and streaming compatibility.
Fixed download reliability, memory leaks, and Android build stability.
